name: Chao Chia
bio: Chao Chia is dated by Giles to the 9th century AD. His poem here is a solitary evening by the river, recalling absent friends.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Where Are They?
poems.author: Chao Chia
poems.text:
Alone I mount to the kiosque which stands on the river-bank, and sigh,
While the moonbeams dance on the tops of the waves where the waters touch the sky;
For the lovely scene is to last year's scene as like as like can be.
All but the friends, the much-loved friends, who gazed at the moon with me.
